ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the middle of the circuit diagram is element A, with the left end connected to terminal a and the right end connected to terminal b. The voltage U is marked below the element, with a positive sign “+” on the left side and a negative sign “-” on the right side. On the left wire there is a rightward current reference arrow, labeled -2 A, indicating that this reference current direction is from left to right and enters the positive voltage terminal of A. Reasoning: According to the passive sign convention, when the reference current direction enters the positive voltage terminal of the element, the absorbed power p = U i. The problem gives that element A absorbs power 20 W, and in the figure this reference current i = -2 A, therefore 20 = U × (-2). Solving gives U = -10 V.

raw_record.question_text: In the circuit shown in the figure, if component A absorbs power of 20 W, then the voltage \(U\) is ______ V.

method.method_draft: Describe the circuit markings, then take the left-to-right current reference as entering A's positive-voltage terminal. Since the image labels that referenced current as i = -2 A and the text says A absorbs p = 20 W, write 20 = U(-2). Solve U = -10 V.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：电路图中间是元件 A，左端接端子 a，右端接端子 b。元件下方标出电压 U，左侧为正号“+”，右侧为负号“-”。左侧导线上有一个向右的电流参考箭头，标注为 -2 A，表示该参考电流方向为从左到右、进入 A 的正电压端。

推理：按被动符号约定，电流参考方向进入元件正电压端时，吸收功率 p = U i。题目给出元件 A 吸收功率 20 W，图中该参考电流 i = -2 A，因此 20 = U × (-2)。解得 U = -10 V。

method.method_draft: First convert the label -2 A on the left-to-right arrow into the actual current: 2 A flows from right to left through A, entering the terminal marked negative for U. For an element with current entering the negative terminal, absorbed power is p = -U(2 A). The text gives absorbed power as 20 W, so 20 = -2U and U = -10 V.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个两端元件 A，左端为 a、右端为 b；电压 U 标注为左端“+”、右端“-”；左侧有一个指向右方的电流参考箭头，标注为 -2 A。推理：参考箭头向右但数值为 -2 A，说明实际电流大小为 2 A，方向与箭头相反，即从右向左流过 A。由于 U 的右端是负端，实际电流从右端进入 A，也就是进入电压的负端。电流进入负端时，元件吸收功率 p = -U·I。已知 A 吸收功率为 20 W，所以 20 = -U × 2，解得 U = -10 V。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read from the image that the arrow drawn on the left points into A from left to right but is labeled -2 A, and that U has polarity + at the left terminal and - at the right terminal.

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: A negative current relative to a drawn arrow means the actual current flows opposite the arrow. If actual current enters the negative-voltage terminal of an element, the absorbed power is the negative of voltage times that actual current magnitude, relative to the shown voltage polarity.
